tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: App background (screen ground). Overlay a 1px/4px scanline: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(243,239,230,0.04) 0 1px, transparent 1px 4px).

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, chat bubbles from the tutor, list rows.

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Raised surface: flashcard back, selected list row, modal sheet.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg-000/100/200 (16.4:1 on bg-000).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, placeholders, inactive tab labels (7.8:1 on bg-000).

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on yellow, cyan, pink and article fills.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and idle card borders ONLY (2.7:1, not enough for a control boundary).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of idle controls (option buttons, unchecked toggles) — 4.3:1 on bg-000, 3.5:1 on bg-200.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Primary action fill (one per screen), active tab label, selected mood/option, XP numbers.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Focus ring, text-input border, top-bar labels, CORRECT answer state (always with a check icon).

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Section labels (01 / FLASHCARDS), hard offset shadow on primary buttons, WRONG answer state (always with a cross icon), record button.

tokens.name: article-der
tokens.usage: Masculine nouns: chip fill, word underline, flashcard edge. Always shown with the word 'der'.

tokens.name: article-die
tokens.usage: Feminine nouns. Always shown with the word 'die'. Differs from pink by context (chips vs feedback) — never use it for errors.

tokens.name: article-das
tokens.usage: Neuter nouns. Always shown with the word 'das'.

tokens.name: article-plural
tokens.usage: Plural form (die … Pl.). Drawn as an OUTLINED chip (2px dashed) so it never relies on hue next to das-green, which has the same lightness.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Correct-answer border and icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Wrong-answer border and icon; destructive confirm.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Screen title on mobile home. Desktop: 64px/64px. Text-shadow 3px 0 pink, -3px 0 cyan.

groups.name: Pixel UI (VT323 + Pixelify Sans for Cyrillic)

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels, top bar, tab bar. Uppercase.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Short UI copy, tutor quotes, button secondary labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Hints, metadata, timestamps. Minimum pixel size.

groups.name: Content (IBM Plex Sans: Latin + umlauts + Cyrillic)

styles.name: word-xl
styles.usage: Flashcard front. Keeps German noun capitalisation (Bungee is unicase and would hide it).

styles.name: word-l
styles.usage: Word in lists, plural line, options.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: Am Bahnhof wartet eine Frau mit einem großen Koffer.
styles.usage: Read-aloud story text. Max line length 34em; target words underlined 3px in their article colour.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Translation under a word, small metadata in content.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, grid gap of option buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card inner padding (horizontal) on mobile lists.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between stacked cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between screen sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Mobile screen side gutter; desktop card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop section gap; tablet gutter.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target (height/width); desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Mobile top safe padding (status bar area).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Primary button height; desktop page top padding.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, cards, inputs, chips.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Only progress bar segments.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Record button and avatar dot only.

tokens.name: shadow-hard
tokens.usage: Primary button and active flashcard. Pressed: translate(4px,4px) and shadow none.

tokens.name: shadow-hard-lg
tokens.usage: Hero cards: today's lesson card, test card.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Min height/width of any tappable element.

tokens.name: size-tabbar
tokens.usage: Mobile bottom tab bar height (plus safe-area inset).

tokens.name: size-rail
tokens.usage: Desktop left navigation rail width (≥1024px).

tokens.name: size-content
tokens.usage: Max width of lesson task column on tablet/desktop.

tokens.name: size-page
tokens.usage: Max width of desktop dashboard grid.

tokens.name: size-flashcard-h
tokens.usage: Flashcard height on mobile (desktop 420px).

tokens.name: bp-mobile
tokens.usage: Design frame 390x844. One column, bottom tab bar.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Gutter 32px; lesson column centered at 720px.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: Left rail 240px replaces tab bar; dashboard 12-col grid, 24px gap.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: Design frame 1440x900; content capped at 1200px.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Button press, chip select. Use steps(2) easing for pixel feel.

tokens.name: dur-flip
tokens.usage: Flashcard flip (rotateY).

tokens.name: dur-reward
tokens.usage: XP count-up after a task. Respect prefers-reduced-motion: show final value.
